items.title: Hal Espinosa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 20, 2024
items.q: I was offered a job at Basin Street East by Leo Ball... he asked me if I would work with him at Basin Street East

ctx.x: Were you surprised years later when Bill Chase had success in the rock world?

I was surprised. You know when — I was offered a job at Basin Street East by Leo Ball, who is a trumpet player in New York, well known and a good politician. You know I played with some rehearsal bands in New York when I was there a few times. And so he liked what I was doing and he asked me if I would work with him at Basin Street East, he was getting a trumpet section. So we had maybe three or four weeks ‘til it started. So I gave Buddy my notice and right after I did that I got a call from a trumpet player…
What year was this? Can you remind me what year? © Fillius Jazz Archive -7-
